name: F1 Trillion
description: Post Malone has officially announced his country album, F-1 Trillion, is out August 16th via Mercury Records/Republic. He’s also dropped the latest duet from the project, “Pour Me a Drink” featuring Blake Shelton.

name: Let It Be
description: "Let It Be" is the Beatles final studio album, released on May 8, 1970. Produced by Phil Spector, it includes iconic tracks like "Let It Be," "Get Back," and "The Long and Winding Road." Recorded during tense sessions in early 1969, the album received mixed reviews but was commercially successful. It marks the end of the Beatles career as a band and remains a classic in their discography..

name: IGOR
description: "Igor" is the fifth studio album of Tyler, The Creator, released on May 17, 2019. It is a concept album exploring themes of love and heartbreak, blending hip-hop, R&B, neo-soul, and funk. Key tracks include "EARFQUAKE" and "A BOY IS A GUN*." The album received critical acclaim, debuted at number one on the Billboard 200, and won Best Rap Album at the 2020 Grammy Awards. "Igor" is praised for its innovative production and emotional depth, marking a significant evolution in artistry of Tyler.

name: Call Me If You Get Lost
description: "Call Me If You Get Lost" is the sixth studio album of Tyler, The Creator, released on June 25, 2021. The album blends rap, jazz, and soul, showcasing his versatility and lyrical prowess. It features notable tracks like "LUMBERJACK" and "WUSYANAME" and includes guest appearances from artists like Lil Wayne and Pharrell Williams. The album received widespread critical acclaim for its production and storytelling, debuting at number one on the Billboard 200. It solidifies his reputation as a multifaceted and innovative artist.

name: Hollywoods Bleeding
description: "Hollywood s Bleeding" is Post Malone s third studio album, released on September 6, 2019. The album blends hip-hop, pop, and rock, featuring hit singles like "Circles," "Wow.," and "Sunflower" with Swae Lee. It includes guest appearances from artists such as Ozzy Osbourne, Travis Scott, and Halsey. The album received positive reviews for its genre-blending sound and Post Malone s versatile performance. It debuted at number one on the Billboard 200 and was a commercial success, solidifying Post Malone s status as a prominent figure in contemporary music.

name: Flower Boy
description: "Flower Boy" is the fourth studio album, released on July 21, 2017. The album marks a shift towards a more introspective and melodic style, blending hip-hop, R&B, and jazz influences. Key tracks include "See You Again," "Boredom," and "911 / Mr. Lonely." It features collaborations with artists like Frank Ocean and A$AP Rocky. "Flower Boy" received widespread critical acclaim for its mature themes and cohesive production, debuting at number two on the Billboard 200. The album is considered a turning point in his career, showcasing his growth as an artist.

name: Thriller
description: "Thriller" is the sixth studio album, released on November 30, 1982. Blending pop, rock, funk, and R&B, it includes iconic tracks like "Billie Jean," "Beat It," and "Thriller." Produced by Quincy Jones, the album features guest appearances by Paul McCartney and Eddie Van Halen. "Thriller" received widespread critical acclaim and became the best-selling album of all time, winning eight Grammy Awards. Its groundbreaking music videos and innovative production solidified his status as the "King of Pop."

name: Ngbthg
description: Ngbthg is Ngot s second studio product, first released in September 2017. Ngbthg small bag version box - released in 2020 - contains a small drawstring bag measuring 19 x 15cm with 100% cotton material, a music record and booklet.

name: 3 (tuyển tập nhạc Ngọt mới trẻ sôi động 2019)
description: Their third and latest album, 3 (Tuyen Tap Nhac Ngot Moi Tre Soi Dong), doesnt make a big impression upon first listen, at least not compared to previous albums snappy, attention-catching and melodic riffs that urgently draw in listeners to their stories and points of contemplation. It does, however, foster enough of a sense of familiarity and strangeness to warrant a second listen. The more times I went through the album, the more I wanted to revisit, the more my feelings pointed me towards the conclusion that it might be the band’s best work so far.

name: Gieo
description: "Gieo" is an album by Vietnamese indie band Ngot, known for its unique blend of pop, rock and folk influences. Released in 2018, the album features introspective lyrics and catchy melodies, capturing themes of youth, love, and self-discovery. Accordingly, album "Gieo" was nominated in the category Best Boxed or Special Limited Edition Package - Best design for an album. The nominated individual is Duy Dao - the person behind the design for this album.

name: Dangerous
description: "Dangerous" is the eighth studio album, released on November 13, 1991. The album incorporates a mix of pop, rock, R&B, and new jack swing, featuring hits like "Black or White," "Remember the Time," and "Heal the World." Produced by Michael Jackson, Teddy Riley, and others, "Dangerous" received critical acclaim and was a commercial success, selling millions of copies worldwide. Its innovative production, socially conscious themes, and groundbreaking music videos reinforced his legacy as the "King of Pop."

name: Christmas
description: "Christmas" is an album by Michael Bublé, released on October 21, 2011. It features classic Christmas songs such as "Jingle Bells," "White Christmas," and "Santa Claus Is Coming to Town," along with original tracks like "Cold December Night." Known for his smooth vocals and traditional pop style, this album became a holiday favorite, blending nostalgia with contemporary flair. "Christmas" topped charts worldwide and has since become a staple during the holiday season, showcasing his charm and timeless interpretation of Christmas classics.

name: Love
description: "Love" is an album by Michael Bublé, released on November 16, 2018. It features a collection of romantic standards and pop classics such as "When I Fall in Love," "Love You Anymore," and "La Vie en Rose." Known for his velvety voice and classic pop style, this album explores themes of love and relationships with warmth and sincerity. "Love" received positive reviews for its polished production and heartfelt performances, showcasing his enduring appeal as a modern-day crooner.

name: Austin
description: Post Malone s album "Austin" showcases his guitar skills prominently, with every track featuring his playing. It shifts away from trap-pop towards various styles of six-string pop-rock. Despite continuing themes of excess drinking and smoking, these vices now serve as integral parts of his introspective storytelling. Tracks like "Chemical" and "Sign Me Up" blend bad romance with nostalgic melodies and candid reflections on relationships and dependencies.

name: Twelve Carat Toothache
description: Twelve Carat Toothache is the fourth studio album by American rapper and singer Post Malone, released on June 3, 2022.

name: Parachutes
description: Parachutes is the debut studio album by British rock band Coldplay released on 10 July 2000 by Parlophone in the United Kingdom.

name: Music of the Spheres
description: "Music of the Spheres" is the ninth studio album, released in 2021. The album features a celestial theme, exploring cosmic and planetary motifs through its music and visual presentation. It includes collaborations with artists like BTS and Selena Gomez, blending pop, rock, and electronic influences. The album standout tracks include "Higher Power," "My Universe," and "Let Somebody Go." It reflects themes of unity, love, and the expansive nature of the universe.

name: A Head Full of Dreams
description: "A Head Full of Dreams" is the seventh studio album, released in 2015. The album is characterized by its upbeat, vibrant sound and incorporates a range of styles including pop, rock, and disco influences. Notable tracks include "Adventure of a Lifetime," "Hymn for the Weekend," and "Up&Up." The album features collaborations with artists like Beyoncé, Tove Lo, and Noel Gallagher. Its themes revolve around love, joy, and a sense of wonder, and it is often seen as a colorful, uplifting counterpart to their previous, more introspective album, "Ghost Stories."
The CD version of the debut album comes from rapper MCK.

name: Đánh Đổi
description: Obito officially released his debut album "Đánh Đổi" with a total of 20 tracks

name: Ái
description: Tlinh debut album includes the hit "Nếu Lúc Đó"

name: LẶNG
description: Having collaborated with Obito on the track "Tell The Kids I Love Them", as well as being known as the producer responsible for Obito s entire album "Đánh Đổi", Shiki this time showed off his versatility in a new role when officially releasing the debut EP "Lặng".

name: LOI CHOI
description: Wren Evans debut album with 11 songs, including the hit "Từng quen"

name: After Hours
description: After Hours is the fourth studio album by the Canadian singer-songwriter the Weeknd. It was released on March 20, 2020 by XO and Republic Records.

name: Dawn FM
description: Dawn FM is the fifth studio album by Canadian singer-songwriter the Weeknd. It was released on January 7, 2022, through XO and Republic Records.
